item.title: 2 Kentucky families speak out in support of the National Marrow Donor Program, unrelated donors
item.description: Two Kentucky families affected by blood cancer are speaking out in support of the National Marrow Donor Program, stressing the critical role unrelated donors play in saving lives.

item.title: Biologist mentioned in Epstein Files connected to University of Kentucky, held lecture in 2016
item.description: Evolutionary biologist Robert Trivers, a man who once spoke at a 2016 lecture at the University of Kentucky, has been named in multiple correspondents with Jeffery Epstein.

item.title: Kentucky falls in its final road game of the season 96-85 at Texas A&M
item.description: Texas A&M hands Kentucky its fourth loss in the last six games with a 96-85 win in College Station. The Wildcats drop to 19-11, 10-7.
